fullContentHtml:
Indian Navy SSC Officer June 2027 Online Form - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Navy (Nausena Bharti) has released the notification for the post of Short Service Commission Officers (SSC) For Various Entries-June 2027 Recruitment. This recruitment has been issued for 241 posts. Online applying process for Indian Navy SSC Officer Recruitment 2026 will start from 25 June 2026 & the candidates can apply till 27 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Indian Navy SSC Officer June 2027 Recruitment which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 June 2026
  • Last Date : 27 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • No Application Fees

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Important Links

  • Apply OnlineApply Online
  • Download NotificationDownload Notification
  • Official WebsiteOfficial Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Indian Navy SSC Officer June 2027 Online Form?

Indian Navy SSC Officer June 2027 Online Form is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 27 July 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
